instructions: Optional: If you reject a code review suggestion, journal why: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <reason>'`.
Commit and push any changes to the PR head.

`$CHANGE_MESSAGE`: one sentence on what changed. Run even if no code changed to dismiss and hide resolved reviews: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --minimize-comment-ids PRR_older_commit,PRR_on_head --dismiss-review-ids PRR_older_commit,PRR_on_head --message "$CHANGE_MESSAGE" --require-sha HEAD`
